body: Pre-registered (research_notes/Allocation/allocation_test_india.md), tools/allocation/backtest.py. Window 2006-04..2026-10 (bond fund NAV binds). Equity=UTI Nifty 50 index fund NAV (regular), gold=GC=F x INR=X -0.5%/yr, bonds=SBI 10y CM gilt fund NAV; 0.1% trade cost, LTCG 10/12.5% eq, 20% gold/bond. Rs10L: 100% eq 10.09% CAGR, 71.8L, DD -55.2%, 70m peak-to-recovery, worst 5y -1.39%. 70/20/10 yearly 10.89%, 83.3L, -38.2%, 21m, +3.98%, beats eq in 33% of 5y windows -> PASS (DD -17pp, CAGR +0.8pp). Bands 5pp same as yearly. 50/50 eq/gold 12.01%, -27%, PASS but gold-dependent (gold 13.2%/yr INR incl. rupee -3.7%/yr; +72% in 2025). Post-hoc: gold at 7% -> 70/20/10 costs 0.38pp, still -16pp DD; start 2009-04 -> DD cut only 10.8pp (benefit concentrated in 2008). P/E tilt 2014-26: 11.33% vs 11.84% fixed, DD -15.1 vs -18.6; literal pass but a fixed 66.9% split gets -17.5% at +0.49pp -> not adopted (cf L51). SIP Rs10k/m: equity 10.53% XIRR, split+Jan reset 11.06% (tax 2.47L), new money to most-underweight 11.30% no tax, but drifted to 60/31/9. Cross-checks: gold Yahoo vs WorldBank x FRED 11.59 vs 11.95% (2006-24); computed gold vs Gold BeES 12.59 vs 12.61% (2009-26); gilt fund vs yield model 7.99 vs 8.13%.
title: India allocation test 2006-2026 (INR): 70/20/10 equity/gold/bonds cut worst fall 55%->38% at no return cost; P/E tilt not adopted; new-money-to-underweight best SIP
